title: Cheese and Swiss Chard Burekitas
subtitle: with tom, kashkaval, feta and goat cheese
description: Crisp yoghurt and vinegar pastry half-moons filled with swiss chard, onion, tom, kashkaval, feta and goat cheese, topped with extra kashkaval.

steps.text: Place all the dough ingredients (flour, 120 ml olive oil, soft butter, vinegar, yoghurt and a generous pinch of salt) in a mixer bowl with a dough hook and knead for 5-7 minutes until smooth. Wrap in cling film and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes and up to 24 hours.

Heat a pan with a little olive oil and fry the chopped onion until golden. Add the finely chopped chard leaves and wilt for about 3 minutes until soft. Cool in a colander for about 15 minutes until all the liquid drains out.

Transfer the chard to a bowl, add the remaining filling ingredients (80 ml olive oil, tom, 100 g of the kashkaval, feta, goat cheese, egg, salt and pepper) and mix until combined. Taste and adjust the seasoning.
Preheat the oven to 180°C and line a tray with baking paper.

Roll the dough between 2 floured sheets of baking paper to 2-3 mm thick and cut 10 cm rounds. Place a spoonful of filling in the centre of each, fold into half-moons and press the edges well with pinches or fork tines. Place on the tray.
Just before baking, brush the burekitas with beaten egg yolk and sprinkle with the remaining grated kashkaval.
Bake for 15-20 minutes until golden and serve immediately.
